title: Closing and goodbyes
summary: The interviewer thanks Purnell, plans to play a record featuring him, and says goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, Alton, I'm going to let you go because I got a record here with you on it, and I'd like to play it, and we're going to tell the people about it. But I think this is a very good example of a very fine pianist who's been doing a tremendous job for a good many years, and I won't tell you how old he is. He looks much younger, I'm sure, than he feels sometimes playing these sessions. But, Alton Pernell, thanks very much for being with us, and we'll see you again soon, maybe?
Thank you. Glad to be here. Yeah, you'll see me again.
